results.title: Per-sequence K bounds remove packed-sequence control work
results.before: Iterate to total packed K and mask inactive iterations
results.after: Iterate only to the current sequence length sk
results.sweep: Hold active sk fixed while increasing unrelated packed sequence lengths and batch count
results.falsification: After latency or scalar activity continues to scale with unrelated packed K

results.title: Direct sparse-head rank removes an O(H) per-program scan
results.before: Scan prior heads to determine sparse-head rank
results.after: Derive rank directly from the known head ordering
results.sweep: Increase head count while holding tokens and active sparse heads fixed
results.falsification: Both versions scale equally with head count

results.title: Moderately larger key tiles amortize loop overhead
results.after: BLOCK_N 128, with 256 and 512 retained as compile/resource probes
results.sweep: Key lengths around every tile boundary with otherwise identical code
results.falsification: Larger tiles do not reduce latency or fail before reducing loop overhead

results.title: Skipping fully masked tiles avoids vector and memory work
results.before: Load and compute every key tile then mask its contribution
results.after: Branch around K/V, score, and softmax work when the entire tile is rejected
results.sweep: Block-aligned sparsity from 0% to 100% at fixed shape
results.falsification: Latency stays flat as rejected-tile fraction increases

results.title: One scalar block-mask decision avoids lane-replicated control work
results.before: Evaluate the block decision across token lanes
results.after: Load and evaluate one scalar decision per block
results.sweep: Increase key length and block count with identical block-aligned masks
results.falsification: Scalarization does not improve long-K cases

results.title: Fine-grained load masking has a predicate-overhead crossover
results.before: Use a simple valid-region mask for K/V loads
results.after: Apply the final token predicate to K/V loads
results.sweep: Regular block masks and increasingly irregular token masks at fixed dimensions
results.falsification: The final predicate never wins even when almost all transferred tokens are rejected

results.title: Warp and stage choices are cheap autotuning variables, not stable profiler diagnoses
results.after: Best schedule from at least 100 cheap timing candidates
results.sweep: Legal warps and stages with source held constant
results.falsification: A stable pipe signature predicts the winner across shapes

results.title: Matrix-tiled tl.dot removes the row-wise reduction bottleneck
results.before: One query/head program using an elementwise product and tl.sum
results.after: Multiple query rows using a matrix-tiled tl.dot
results.sweep: Query rows, head dimension, and key length subject to compile/resource limits
results.falsification: The tiled dot is valid but cannot beat the row-wise reduction on any representative case

results.title: Tiling query rows reuses K/V data
results.after: Multiple query rows per program sharing key/value tiles
results.sweep: Query tile height and K length while recording compile/resource failures
results.falsification: Added resource pressure offsets reuse for every legal query tile

results.title: Dense, causal, streaming, and block-sparse modes have distinct control costs
results.after: Causal, streaming, or block-sparse mode with equal useful tensor work
results.sweep: Mode and sparsity while holding dimensions and useful output elements fixed
results.falsification: Mode does not change latency or activity evidence

results.title: A3 timeline evidence can distinguish ordered phases inside one launch
results.before: Long load, vector, then store phases
results.after: Reverse the phase order without changing phase work
results.sweep: A-B-C, C-B-A, A-B-A, serialized/overlapped, duration sweeps, and fused/separate-kernel control
results.falsification: Available exports contain only aggregate activity or relationships and cannot recover injected order
